VERDICT: PASS - 65e646c233ae64882c2d2e24469e59a2b6f54dc1

Scoped product verification for PR 398: CLIPVisionEncode only.

- PR API remained open/draft on native-vision-conditioning-511 at this exact head before verdict.
- Fresh CPU-only clone: `tests/test_comfy_clip_nodes.py` passed (9); `packages/dinkster-nodes-comfy/tests/test_vision_output_torch.py` passed (6); `bash scripts/ci-fast.sh` passed (350). The vision test runs both in-process and isolated ordinary-manifest hosts, exercising the IMAGE materialization, crop selection, output transport, and repeated execution contracts.
- A live `dinkster-serve --no-default-packs --pack packages/dinkster-nodes-comfy/dinkster-pack.toml` inspection served CLIPVisionEncode as model/conditioning with required CLIP_VISION and IMAGE inputs, crop COMBO center/none defaulting to center, and CLIP_VISION_OUTPUT output. The corrected common fixed-F dump identifies CLIPVisionEncode as identical to bc5f880dbdd43e426077f42ccec53bb577ffee9f.
- Reviewed the five-file diff: no deleted files or tests; implementation registers the public node, preserves the portable IMAGE/crop/output contracts, and uses the public encoder method. The retained owner fixed-F log records four first-new cells exact with input source preservation; it was not rerun.

Out of scope: the unrelated existing ShuffleImageTextDataset schema difference reported by the full registry comparator, StyleModelApply, unCLIPConditioning, issue-wide acceptance, model numerical parity, and landing readiness.
